text:
maria: FYI seeing recurring Xid errors and a node reboot loop on gpu-7.us-west2, started ~40m ago. dmesg shows ECC/Xid bursts.
sam: ugh. can you paste the dmesg snippet? also which partition is this in (preemptible/dedicated)?
maria: Dedicated pool. quick paste of the last dmesg window:

maria: ```
[Mon Mar 15 17:02:01] NVRM: Xid (0004:0011): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus
[Mon Mar 15 17:02:01] kernel: NVRM: GPU 0000:06:00.0: GPU has fallen off the bus.
[Mon Mar 15 17:02:01] kernel: nvidia: probe of 0000:06:00.0 failed with error -110
[Mon Mar 15 17:05:12] kernel: NVRM: Xid (0004:0011): 4, GPU fault at 0x7f2b... (EC)
```

jon: that first line (fallen off the bus) + -110 looks like a hardware detach or flaky pci link. we should collect nvlog, full journal and nv-smi output before draining.

tori: oncall, can you grab logs and start a replacement flow? If this is flaky card we want to drain node and replace card asap.
oncall: I'll grab logs now. checklist I use:

oncall: 1) ssh node, run `sudo journalctl -k -b -1 --no-pager | sed -n '1,200p'` and `sudo dmesg -T | egrep -i 'xid|ecc|fallen off|nvrm'`

oncall: 2) `nvidia-smi -q -d ECC,MIG,FB` and `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,name,serial,uuid,minor_number,driver_model.current --format=csv` -> save to /tmp/gpu-meta-2067890123.txt

oncall: 3) bundle `/var/log/nvidia* /var/log/kern.log /var/crash /var/log/journal/` plus the outputs above into /tmp/gpu-2067890123.tgz

oncall: 4) upload to s3: `aws s3 cp /tmp/gpu-2067890123.tgz s3://redwood-gpu-diagnostics/2067890123/ --acl private`

infra-bot: Incident created: INC-32178 for node gpu-7.us-west2, severity P2. Assigned to Infra Oncall.

sam: thanks. maria, any perf/eviction events from the scheduler? did pods get OOM killed before the Xid?
maria: scheduler shows 2 evictions very close to the first Xid; but pods had restarts after node reboot. no obvious container OOM in the kubelet logs.

jon: while we have the tar, also capture pci slots: `lspci -vvv -s 06:00.0` and `ethtool -i ens3` — sometimes a bad riser or BIOS hiccup looks like a GPU fault.

maria: got lspci output attached in the bundle. serial from nv-smi is SN-ABCD1234, card shows ECC errors incrementing.

tori: given recurring Xid+fallen-off-bus, plan: drain node, set node unschedulable, evict pods gracefully, evacuate to other pool, then tag for hardware replacement. who wants to own the replacement ticket?

jon: I'll own the replacement ticket. can we confirm a repro window? if it reproduces within 1hr after reboot we escalate to vendor RMA.

oncall: drain started: `kubectl drain gpu-7 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=15m` — will monitor.

maria: small note — keep an eye on other nodes in same rack: we saw similar link flaps on gpu-3 last month that ended up being a riser cable.

sam: good call. can infra-bot annotate the node with hardware-status=investigating and rack=rack-14?

infra-bot: Node annotation applied: hardware-status=investigating, rack=rack-14.

oncall: upload done: s3://redwood-gpu-diagnostics/2067890123/gpu-2067890123.tgz

maria: quick grep of the journal shows repeated PCIe AER errors before the Xid. snippet:

maria: ```
[Mon Mar 15 16:59:58] pcieport 0000:00:1c.0: AER: Corrected error, Dev Status: 0x0000
[Mon Mar 15 16:59:59] pcieport 0000:00:1c.0: AER: Multiple Unmatched transactions - RxErr
```

jon: that's consistent with link errors. raises probability of riser/slot. proceed with hardware replacement after pods drained.

tori: I've scheduled a swap for rack tech tomorrow morning, but if it repros immediately after reboot we do hot-swap today.

maria: drain finished, pods moved. node cordoned. marking for replace.

sam: quick doc note for triage playbook: add `lspci -vvv` and `dmesg -T | sed -n '1,300p'` as required captures, and include PCIe AER grep. many threads missed AER lines previously.

jon: agreed — also add `nvidia-smi -q -d MEMORY,ECC | sed -n '1,200p'` to capture ECC counters before reboot.

maria: thanks team. I'll attach the s3 URL to the replacement ticket and keep monitoring for similar patterns in rack-14.

infra-bot: INC-32178 updated: logs uploaded, node drained, replacement ticket assigned to jon.

jon: I'll open RMA with vendor after we get onsite confirmation. ping me if it repros post-reboot.

tori: other note — cost impact: draining one dedicated node ~2% cap reduction; notify capacity-planning if replacements push below commit threshold.

sam: noted. I'll run a quick capacity check and inform growth if we hit 5% of pool down.

maria: closing loop: set alert to watch for Xid 79 or 'fallen off the bus' in the last 24h and add rack-14 to watchlist.

oncall: alert rule created: gpu-fallen-off-bus-rack-14 (threshold: >=1 in 10m). will mute after replacement.

maria: :thumbsup: cheers everyone.
